verdict.rationale: Cua Driver is documented as driving native apps on macOS, Windows and Linux in the background with its own agent cursor, reached through MCP or a CLI. None of the evidence explains how inputs actually reach the device: there is no mention of USB HID, accessibility APIs, synthesized OS input events or any other injection mechanism. The axis clearly applies to a computer-use control product, so the lack of documentation yields "none".

support.subject: As a developer, the control path (USB HID, accessibility APIs, OS input events) is documented, so I know how inputs reach the device
